messages:
josh: Hey team — after upgrading the client lib yesterday our function/tool calls to `create_order` started returning 400s. Error is `Invalid function arguments` and the runtime says 'invalid JSON in tool args'. Happening for many customers.

maria: Oof. Can you paste the exact request body you send (or a minimal repro curl)? Also which runtime version / SDK version are you on?

josh: SDK v2.4.1, runtime v1.8. Sending via curl like this:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "model":"rwd-2-instruct",
    "fn_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"items\": \"[{\\\"id\\\":\\\"sku_123\\\"}]\", \"payment\": {\"method\":\"card\"}}"}
  }'
```
(just redacted token)

maria: I think I see it — `arguments` is a string here (notice lots of escaping) so the runtime receives a string containing JSON rather than a JSON object. The schema for `create_order` expects `items` as an array of objects and `payment` as an object.

josh: If I flip to `json_mode: true` I see a slightly different failure: `400 unexpected token "\\\"" at position 12` when the runtime tries to parse the tool args.

kevin: pinging eng. This looks like a serialization regression in the SDK where `arguments` is being double-encoded when callers pass a pre-serialized string. Two separate problems:
- callers sometimes pass a stringified JSON instead of an object (client mistake)
- SDK started serializing already-stringified arguments again (bug)

kevin: Can you send one full Request-ID from the failing request? Logs will help us trace if the SDK re-serializes.

josh: Request-ID: req_01H9Y2X9ABCDZ. Logs show on the runtime side: `ArgumentValidationError: missing required key items` then `JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)` in the arg parser.

maria: That fits: runtime tried to parse a string and failed to coerce to the declared schema. For a quick repro for eng: please run a simple payload where `arguments` is an object (not a string). Example that works locally:
```
{
  "fn_call": {
    "name": "create_order",
    "arguments": {
      "items": [{"id": "sku_123", "qty": 1}],
      "payment": {"method": "card"}
    }
  }
}
```

josh: Confirmed — switching to an object instead of a string removes the error.

maria: Short-term action: support guidance to customers — ensure `arguments` is a JSON object (not a string). We'll add a note to the SDK changelog and docs. Long-term: eng to prevent double-encoding and improve runtime errors to surface which arg failed and why (type vs missing key). Escalating now.

kevin: Eng plan: (1) add stricter validation with clearer error text (which key failed and expected type), (2) patch SDK serialization to avoid re-serializing stringified args, (3) add a telemetry check to catch this pattern in incoming requests. I created an internal issue.

deploy-bot: Created INC-3452: "SDK double-encoding of fn_call arguments causing JSON-mode parse failures" — assignee kevin, priority P2.

maria: Thanks @josh for the logs. We'll follow up when the SDK patch lands. In the meantime recommend customers validate payloads or use the SDK helper `callFunction({ name, args: <object> })` which ensures proper typing. :white_check_mark:
_meta_notes: thread follows structured-output / json mode tool-args parsing failure. concise slack-style messages with code snippets and escalations to eng
